sentences.text: Challenging the impugned order this appeal has been preferred by submitting that as per the FIR there is no specific allegation against the appellant.
The appellant is innocent and he has falsely been implicated in the present case.
He further submitted that the DNA report is not supported the case of prosecution.
The conclusion of trial will likely to take long time, hence prays for release of the appellant on bail.
4. Counsel for the State opposed the appeal and prayed for dismissal of the same.

5. The report of the Trial Court is to the effect that out of 24 witnesses proposed by the State, only 5 persons have been examined till now and prosecution is not taking interest in presenting the witnesses.
It is also perused that the DNA is not matched.

Therefore, considering the fact and circumstances of the case, coupled with the fact that appellant is in jail since 16.03.2024 and without commenting on the merit of the case, the appeal is NEUTRAL CITATION NO.
2026:MPHC-IND:8089 3 CRA-1224-2026 allowed and the appellant is directed to be released on bail upon his furnishing personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial court for his appearance before that Court, as and when directed, during the pendency of trial and shall also abide by the conditions enumerated under section 480 (3) of the B.N.S.S., 2023.
6.
The appellant shall not contact with the victim in any way either physically or through any other mode of social media, failing which this order shall be liable to be cancelled.

7. Copy of this order be forwarded to the victim in the light of Aparna Bhat vs. State of MP -AIR 2021 SC 1492.
